info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Business Analysi Customer Portfolio-spec
info.description: The Business Analysis Customer Portfolio API allows organizations to streamline the creation of customer portfolios tailored for business analysis purposes. By leveraging this endpoint, users can efficiently develop and manage comprehensive customer profiles that predict behaviors and preferences. Typical consumers include business analysts and financial institutions aiming to enhance their customer relationship management strategies. This API facilitates the integration of various customer data points to support informed decision-making and strategic planning.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new customer portfolio by providing the necessary data. It is designed for business analysts and stakeholders looking to manage and analyze customer assets effectively.

requestBody.description: The details of the customer portfolio that needs to be processed. This includes all relevant information necessary for the business analysis, ensuring that the request is complete and actionable.

201.description: Resource created successfully, reflecting the new customer portfolio data.
